name: IceVault
tagline: Dry, electric cold therapy room. No water, no ice, no nitrogen.
description: The OneBase IceVault is a walk-in cold room that holds 34–40°F (adjustable from 32°F) with electric refrigeration. Up to eight people at once, sessions of 3–15 minutes, no wet floors, no cryogenic gas, and a self-cleaning cycle that keeps it sanitary with minimal staff time. Plug-and-play: one 240 V connection, no plumbing, no drainage.

highlights.title: Dry cold immersion
highlights.body: Electric refrigeration holds a consistent 35°F (adjustable 32–40°F) without water or ice. No mess, fewer slip risks, no gas exposure.

highlights.title: Commercial-grade build
highlights.body: Smooth insulated panels, anti-slip flooring and LED lighting for a safe, comfortable and immersive space.

highlights.title: Throughput
highlights.body: Walk-in access for up to 8 users per session, from athletes to first-timers. Longer, more tolerable sessions than a plunge.

highlights.title: Plug and play
highlights.body: Self-contained. One power connection. No plumbing or drainage required.

highlights.title: Self-cleaning
highlights.body: Automated cleaning cycles keep the room sanitary with minimal upkeep; remote diagnostics and support included.

highlights.title: Low running cost
highlights.body: Runs on electricity with low ongoing costs compared with ice baths or cryotherapy chambers.

faqs.a: A self-contained, dry cold-immersion room that uses electric refrigeration to hold 34–40°F, delivering the benefits of cold exposure without water, ice or nitrogen.

faqs.q: How is it different from a cold plunge or cryotherapy chamber?
faqs.a: No water or ice. No setup, cleanup or wet floors. Longer sessions (3–15 minutes) at tolerable temperatures. Multiple users at once. Less maintenance.
Yes. It removes the gas-exposure risk of cryotherapy and the slippery wet floors of ice baths. Breathable air and controlled temperatures keep the experience comfortable.

faqs.q: How many people can use it at once?

faqs.a: An automated self-cleaning system keeps the environment sanitary with minimal effort. Remote support handles diagnostics and troubleshooting.
